title: Genealogy_Shared_Definitions_Legacy_Wrapper
description: Backward-compatible wrapper referencing canonical definitions across modular schema definitions (_shared_defs, _death_defs, _document_defs, _external_xref_defs). Maintained to ensure uninterrupted resolution for legacy schema pointers.

person_id.description: Canonical internal person identifier matching pattern IND- followed by five digits. Managed in people.json.

temp_person_id.description: Ephemeral staging identifier matching pattern TMP- followed by five digits.

any_person_id.description: Accepts either an established canonical IND-##### identifier or an ephemeral TMP-##### staging identifier.

location_id.description: Canonical internal location identifier matching pattern LOC- followed by five digits.

fact_id.description: Canonical RFC 4122 compliant UUID (GUID) uniquely identifying a discrete fact assertion.

note_id.description: Canonical internal note identifier matching pattern NOT- followed by five digits.

quality_assessment.description: Standardized qualitative assessment rating text legibility or scan quality.

quay_score.description: Standard genealogical quality assessment of evidence (maps to GEDCOM QUAY).

date_iso.description: ISO-8601 calendar date or partial date formatted as YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

date_interpreted.description: Structured date container breaking complex or uncertain genealogical dates into normalized ISO ranges alongside verbatim text.

age_record.description: Standardized container capturing chronological age expressed in completed years, months, days, or unparsed verbatim text.

vital_year.description: Four-digit calendar year container paired with a certainty modifier flag.

canonical_name.description: Structured canonical personal name, documentary raw representation, and core vital boundary markers.

associated_role.description: Standardized genealogical association role defining a secondary participant's relationship to an event (maps to GEDCOM ASSO/ROLE).

associated_person_entry.description: Participant linked to an archival record or fact assertion, aligning with GEDCOM ASSO/ROLE/RELA conventions.

location_details.description: Detailed physical address, micro-jurisdictions, and coordinate points mapping directly to GEDCOM ADDR and MAP structures.

location.description: Standardized genealogical place entity providing normalized lookup, historical transcription, and physical address breakdown.

cause_of_death.description: Structured medical certification and etiology detailing manner, causes, and circumstances of death.

source_media.description: Derivative scan image metadata and legibility assessment for an archival source record.

news_clipping.description: Physical clipping segment metadata linking visual scans to page and layout positions.

transcript_record.description: Structured transcript container providing verbatim text, abstract, search keywords, word count, and standalone file linkages.

external_identifiers.description: Cross-reference container mapping internal IND-##### persons to external software pointers, global UUIDs, and repositories.

fact_external_identifiers.description: Cross-reference container mapping internal fact assertions to external GEDCOM event records and source citations.

note_entry.description: Structured annotation or research task linked to an entity or fact.
